instruction: Accept all pending Venmo payment requests from my coworkers and friends.
notes: Two-app task: phone contacts give the email addresses of coworkers and friends; Venmo lists pending received payment requests and approves those whose sender email belongs to that set. Contacts are modeled with a static (has-relationship person relationship) fact and phone-search-contacts asserts (contacts-searched relationship) for the relationship it queried; approval requires the sender's relationship to be a target relationship (coworker/friend) that has been searched and the pending list to have been retrieved, mirroring the information flow of the reference solution. The problem contains one representative pending request per category (coworker, friend) plus one from a non-target contact (sibling) that must not be touched; only the two eligible requests appear in the goal. At runtime the approve step is repeated for every matching pending request across all pages. supervisor-complete-task carries the two eligible requests as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the goal; it is called with no answer (status success). Only approved_at changes on the affected requests, satisfying the evaluation.
